readOnlyProbes.purpose: Recapture version/name ledger and compare to pinned snapshot before any decision.
readOnlyProbes.sql: select version, name from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations order by version

readOnlyProbes.purpose: Prove whether any V1 Razorpay function exists and with which definition.
readOnlyProbes.sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, md5(pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)) as def_md5 from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'qf\_%razorpay%' order by 1

readOnlyProbes.purpose: Detect partial prior apply of the V1 column expansion.
readOnlyProbes.sql: select column_name, data_type from information_schema.columns where table_schema = 'public' and table_name = 'vendor_package_orders' and column_name in ('provider_amount_subunits','provider_receipt','provider_order_request_token','provider_order_requested_at') order by 1

readOnlyProbes.purpose: Only if P03 shows the token column: count unbound created orders that a V1 first claim would reject.
readOnlyProbes.sql: select count(*) filter (where provider_order_request_token is null) as null_token_unbound, count(*) filter (where provider_order_request_token is not null) as token_held_unbound from public.vendor_package_orders where provider_order_id is null and order_status = 'created'

readOnlyProbes.purpose: Confirm no client role could reach any V1 function.
readOnlyProbes.sql: select p.oid::regprocedure::text as signature, has_function_privilege('anon', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as anon_exec, has_function_privilege('authenticated', p.oid, 'EXECUTE') as auth_exec from pg_proc p join pg_namespace n on n.oid = p.pronamespace where n.nspname = 'public' and p.proname like 'qf\_%razorpay%' order by 1

requires: Recaptured ledger must equal pinned snapshot sha256 c43c8f0d36889cf94881ffb279e2ece8653f392103b6d07741388c229509723e or this plan is void
Evidence from managed platform owner; not producible by this tool
Catalog object diff baseline vs pre-baseline source; version ordering is not evidence
Applied statement or function-definition hash comparison per pair
Determine which reapply is authoritative and whether the earlier one partially applied
Recover SQL into reviewed source before any release; never re-derive by guess
Historical V1 must not be replayed or hand-fixed in place
V2 review candidate stays uninstalled until Finance+DBA+AppSec adjudication
Per file: prove objects absent/present read-only; out-of-order replay is forbidden
Separate reviewed packet per migration after S00-S07 close with real external signatures

rollback.note: Supabase migrations have no down scripts. Any future install needs a recorded PITR point, logical dump and a separately reviewed forward-fix; none exists in this plan.
